closed_engineering_findings.closure: Complete source/config inventory is checked before training and held evaluation.
Original paths and parents are checked before resolve.
Five selected models and complete selection receipts were remotely sealed and verified before held execution.
All sealed held files and declared counts are checked without modifying their identity.
Access attempt is recorded before loading, including conservative failure status.
Source hashes include ASSETS metadata only; parameter readers do not open codec/residual payloads.
All eight actual candidates match the disclosed development revision and formal protocol.
Unknown SOURCE paths and non-dictionary or empty inventories are rejected.

remaining_research_or_evidence_obligatio.closure: A newly frozen representation and independently authored evaluation must jointly reach >=80% correct acceptance and <=5% OOD acceptance.
remaining_research_or_evidence_obligatio.evidence: 12/144 correct accepted; 2/72 OOD accepted in every case. Raw correct 97/144 bounds threshold-only repair below 80%.

remaining_research_or_evidence_obligatio.closure: Meet both ablation gains with actual routing, and separately demonstrate combinations across genuine memory types and new tasks.
remaining_research_or_evidence_obligatio.evidence: Gain over removed edges is 12/120; gain over compatible node permutation is only 6/120. Both >=12/120 are required.

remaining_research_or_evidence_obligatio.closure: A preregistered equal-budget single/fixed/adaptive comparison must demonstrate value after all training, routing and maintenance costs.
remaining_research_or_evidence_obligatio.evidence: Same-router parameter and strong-codec answers tie; parameter deployment uses 9,490 more bytes. No controlled same-budget architecture comparison in V5.

remaining_research_or_evidence_obligatio.closure: Retain a complete fresh run with replay, version corrections, revoked knowledge, retention and stale-propagation fault cases.
remaining_research_or_evidence_obligatio.evidence: V5 does not add continual-learning, correction, distributed revocation or retention trials. Historical partial V4 evidence is not a complete new qualification.

remaining_research_or_evidence_obligatio.closure: Actual child training and routing migration must beat a strong fixed comparator on preregistered new flows with lifecycle costs included.
remaining_research_or_evidence_obligatio.evidence: Four numerical memories and the old learned graph layout are fixed; no V5 split, merge or consolidation training occurs.

remaining_research_or_evidence_obligatio.closure: Transfer write/address/compose policies across held domains, memory types and task families, with explicit capacity/distortion accounting.
remaining_research_or_evidence_obligatio.evidence: Four numerical series share six supplied operations and one schema; synthetic English language qualification fails. No new type invention or general program memory is demonstrated.

remaining_research_or_evidence_obligatio.closure: Recover a complete original backup or retain a distinctly named complete rerun; do not label new files as recovered originals.
remaining_research_or_evidence_obligatio.evidence: 155/6,181 original formal outputs recovered; 6,026 absent. V5 is a new run and cannot restore their historical identity.
